name: rustup
description: The inspected rustup self-update body supports a primary C observation, but the prior SHA-256 claim does not apply to this self-update path: it directly uses DownloadOptions::download and then runs the downloaded rustup-init. The repository has a separate checksum helper for distribution downloads, but that is not called by prepare_update in the cited code.
limitations: Newly retrieved snapshot at the recorded commit, not historical release verification.
No cryptographic verification of the rustup-init payload is established by the self-update body.
The DownloadOptions transport implementation and release hosting are separate boundaries.
